summary: Team Reptile's competitive arena series, combining fighting-game timing with high-speed ball rallies and local/online multiplayer.

entries.title: Lethal League
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with current updates

primary.why: Lethal League released first on Windows in 2014, later adding OS X and Linux through Humble Indie Bundle 17 and PlayStation 4/Xbox One console versions in 2017. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for local/online competitive play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version with current updates; use PS4/Xbox One only for console multiplayer access.

primary.why: Lethal League Blaze released for Windows in October 2018, followed by PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch in July 2019. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the 3D follow-up.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Switch for portable play or PS4/Xbox One for console sessions.
